totals.counts_scope: One selected attempt per ID per phase; promotions and replays are explicitly included, not presented as new designs. Raw operator/fixture calls are excluded.
totals.technically_valid_definition: All declared stages completed with finite valid/manifold/closed geometry and no 30-contact sample cap. CLEAN_SAMPLE is not a collision certificate.

visual.dominant_limitation: A: tested face-local constructions retain the parent-cell scaffold

criteria.multi_cell_meso: Partial adjacent chevron alignment; no dominant coherent assembly
criteria.visibly_nested: Yes, inherited rings/caps and small crests within side frames
criteria.terminal_crispness: Large crests crisp; micro crests thin
criteria.preferred_contact_state: CLEAN_SAMPLE for ordered Hero, not a collision certificate
criteria.human_acceptance: Not performed; no human endorsement inferred

limitations: Aggressive end/branch growth pinches and contacts nearby surfaces
Sparse new ridges improve angular order but do not build new junctions
visual.review_scope: Agent inspection of actual fixed-camera polygons; no human review or Rhino run

observations.F_B5_01: Broad side crests form some aligned chevrons/ribbons; 20 graph patches span parent cells and roots, but repetition remains.
observations.R_B5_02_2: Actual translated side caps form offset plates; no continuous cross-cell fin.
observations.R_B5_03_4: Front-biased Roof-END extrusion reduces side/up contact growth and gives small shelves; isolated one-face patches.
observations.HERO_ORDERED_RIDGES: Upper flank crests plus nested small crests; depth five but overall panel scaffold persists.
observations.HERO_BRANCHING_PLATES: Crests added on directional cap plates cause 30-contact cap; preceding stage stable; failure retained.

primary_geometry_omission: Local primary meshes remain; compact review omits redundant terminals except six early identity-audit cases.
